$comment: Smart typography — Tier B: the corpus, and the contract between quilltap-server (v4) and quilltap-v5.
These fixtures live beside the engine rather than in the repo's usual __tests__/fixtures/ because v5 copies
the whole lib/smart-typography directory wholesale. Keep the deviation; it is the point.
Every row exists to protect a stated invariant. If a port disagrees with a row, fix the port, not the row.
`options` is optional per case and falls back to `defaultOptions`. `expect: null` means no substitution.

cases.name: second hyphen becomes an en dash
third hyphen promotes the en dash to an em dash
fourth hyphen does nothing — the ladder ends, and this is the escape hatch
second dot is not yet an ellipsis
a dot after an existing ellipsis is a deliberate fourth dot
only two dots of context, no third character — still an ellipsis
dashes off suppresses the dash ladder
ellipsis still fires when only dashes are off
a reserved delimiter is never substituted
reservedChars naming an unrelated character does not suppress
a non-trigger character is never touched
